name: Alerts Format
description: Provides styling support for the Alerts recipe.
project_description: Companion module for the Alerts recipe. Its single hook_views_pre_render() implementation targets the 'alerts' View: it loads published taxonomy terms from the 'alert_severity' vocabulary, reads each term's field_color value, and injects an inline <style> block mapping each severity term id to a .alert-severity-<tid> { background: <color> } rule so alert banners are colored by severity. The optional Alerts Format - Olivero submodule attaches a small CSS/JS library (full-width banner styling plus a client-side, localStorage-backed dismiss button) when that same View renders under the Olivero theme. Provides no routes, no permissions, no services, no plugins, and no configuration UI of its own.
